name: gaming
description: Game library and device workflows: verified onboarding, non-destructive sync, device snapshots, emulator settings and cheats, sharing one profile across hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Game library, device and emulator workflows.
interface.longDescription: Gaming keeps a verified, system-first game library, backs it up without deletions, snapshots devices, records each device's frontend setup as a baseline, and handles emulator settings and cheats. One profile shared by Claude Code and Codex remembers libraries, devices and how to reach them.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me manage my game library and devices.
